apiVersion: v2
name: search-api
description: A Helm chart for Kubernetes

# A chart can be either an 'application' or a 'library' chart.
#
# Application charts are a collection of templates that can be packaged into versioned archives
# to be deployed.
#
# Library charts provide useful utilities or functions for the chart developer. They're included as
# a dependency of application charts to inject those utilities and functions into the rendering
# pipeline. Library charts do not define any templates and therefore cannot be deployed.
type: application

# This is the chart version. This version number should be incremented each time you make changes
# to the chart and its templates, including the app version.
# Versions are expected to follow Semantic Versioning (https://semver.org/)
version: 0.1.0

# This is the version number of the application being deployed. This version number should be
# incremented each time you make changes to the application. Versions are not expected to
# follow Semantic Versioning. They should reflect the version the application is using.
# It is recommended to use it with quotes.
appVersion: "1.16.0"

# Default values for search-admin.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.
# Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

# This will set the replicaset count more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/replicaset/
replicaCount: 1

# 컨테이너 배열 설정 - 1 Pod에 여러 컨테이너 지원
containers:
  # 첫 번째 컨테이너: search-admin
  - name: search-admin
    image:
      repository: harbor.cowave.kr/search/search-admin
      pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      tag: "latest"
    ports:
      - name: search-admin-http
        containerPort: 8080
        protocol: TCP
    envFrom:
      # 공통 ConfigMap 참조
      - configMapRef:
          name: next-search-common-config
      # 서비스 특화 ConfigMap 참조
      - configMapRef:
          name: cmn-search-admin-config
    resources:
      limits:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 1Gi
      requests:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 1Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: search-dictionary
        mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/plugins/analysis-danuri/dict
    livenessProbe: {}
    readinessProbe: {}

  # 두 번째 컨테이너: 사이드카 예시 (필요에 따라 수정)
  - name: search-admin-ui
    image:
      repository: harbor.cowave.kr/search/search-admin-ui
      pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      tag: "latest"
    ports:
      - name: search-admin-ui-http
        containerPort: 3000
        protocol: TCP
    envFrom: []
    resources:
      limits:
        cpu: 200m
        memory: 256Mi
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 128Mi
    volumeMounts: []
    livenessProbe: {}
    readinessProbe: {}

# This is for the secrets for pulling an image from a private repository more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/pull-image-private-registry/
imagePullSecrets:
  - name: search-harbor-cowave-secret
# This is to override the chart name.
nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: "cmn-search-admin"

# This section builds out the service account more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/
serviceAccount:
  # Specifies whether a service account should be created
  create: true
  # Automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials?
  automount: true
  # Annotations to add to the service account
  annotations: {}
  # The name of the service account to use.
  # If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template
  name: ""

# This is for setting Kubernetes Annotations to a Pod.
# For more information checkout: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/annotations/
podAnnotations: {}
# This is for setting Kubernetes Labels to a Pod.
# For more information checkout: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/
podLabels: {}

podSecurityContext: {}
  # fsGroup: 2000

securityContext: {}
  # capabilities:
  #   drop:
  #   - ALL
  # readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  # runAsNonRoot: true
  # runAsUser: 1000

# This is for setting up a service more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/
service:
  # This sets the service type more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#publishing-services-service-types
  type: ClusterIP
  # This sets the ports more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#field-spec-ports
  port: 3000

httpRoute:
  enabled: false

# This block is for setting up the ingress for more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/
ingress:
  enabled: false
  className: ""
  annotations: {}
    # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
    # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
  hosts:
    - host: chart-example.local
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: ImplementationSpecific
  tls: []
  #  - secretName: chart-example-tls
  #    hosts:
  #      - chart-example.local

# This section is for setting up autoscaling more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/autoscaling/
autoscaling:
  enabled: false
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 100
  targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
  # targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80

# Additional volumes on the output Deployment definition.
volumes:
  - name: search-dictionary
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: search-dictionary-shared-pvc

# Additional volumeMounts on the output Deployment definition.
# volumeMounts는 이제 containers 배열 내에서 각 컨테이너별로 설정
volumeMounts:
 - name: search-dictionary
   mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/plugins/analysis-danuri/dict

nodeSelector: {}

tolerations: []

affinity: {}

# ConfigMap 설정
config:
  dictionary:
    outputPath: "/usr/share/elasticsearch/plugins/analysis-danuri/dict"

# 공통 ConfigMap 참조
commonConfig:
  name: "cmn-search-config"

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# Lint a service chart
helm lint apps/next-search/<service>

# Template dry-run with environment values
helm template <service> apps/next-search/<service> \
  -f apps/next-search/<service>/values/values-dev.yaml

# Template shared-resources (no default values.yaml)
helm template shared-resources apps/next-search/shared-resources \
  -f apps/next-search/shared-resources/values/values-dev.yaml

# Create Harbor pull secret
apps/next-search/script/harbor-secret.sh
```

## Architecture

next-search는 검색 플랫폼의 마이크로서비스 Helm 차트 모음이다. 모든 서비스는 Spring Boot 기반이며, 환경변수 주입 방식(envFrom)으로 설정을 관리한다.

### 환경변수 주입 계층 (3-layer ConfigMap/Secret 패턴)

모든 서비스는 `envFrom`으로 다음 3가지를 순서대로 참조한다 (나중 것이 앞의 것을 override):

1. **공통 ConfigMap** (`{env}-cmn-search-config`) — `shared-resources/`에서 생성. ES, Valkey, MongoDB, Keyword Analysis 연결 정보
2. **서비스 특화 ConfigMap** (`{env}-cmn-{service}-config`) — 각 서비스의 `templates/configmap.yaml`에서 생성. OTEL, 인덱스 설정 등
3. **Secret** (`{env}-cmn-search-credentials`) — `secret/` 디렉토리의 매니페스트를 클러스터에서 직접 적용. ES API Key, Valkey 비밀번호, Kafka SASL 등

### 서비스별 차이점

| 서비스 | ConfigMap 특징 | Deployment 패턴 | 비고 |
|--------|---------------|-----------------|------|
| **search-api** | OTEL + index 설정만 (심플) | 단일 컨테이너 | Ingress nginx |
| **legacy-sync** | search-api와 동일 패턴 | 단일 컨테이너 | Ingress nginx |
| **dynamic-indexer** | OTEL + index + Kafka CDC 3개 토픽 + client URL | 단일 컨테이너 | Ingress 미사용 |
| **search-admin** | Dictionary path만 | **Multi-container** (admin + admin-ui) | HTTPRoute 지원, `containers[]` 배열 방식 |

### Chart naming 컨벤션

- `Chart.yaml`의 `name`은 서비스 이름 그대로 (예: `search-api`, `legacy-sync`)
  - 예외: `dynamic-indexer`는 `name: dev-cmn-dynamic-indexer`로 환경 prefix 포함
- 환경 prefix는 `values/values-{env}.yaml`의 `nameOverride`/`fullnameOverride`에서 부여
  - dev: `dev-cmn-{service}`, prod: `cmn-{service}`
- `otelServiceName` 패턴: `{cluster}.{namespace}.{fullname}` (예: `backend-was.cmn-search.cmn-search-api`)

### shared-resources

`shared-resources/`는 `values.yaml`이 없는 특수 차트. 반드시 환경별 values 파일을 지정해야 한다. 공통 ConfigMap만 생성하며, 모든 서비스가 이를 참조한다.

### Image Registry

모든 이미지는 `harbor.cowave.kr/search/{service}` 경로를 사용하며, pull secret은 `search-harbor-cowave-secret`이다.

### Observability 설정 (모든 서비스 공통)

OTEL Java agent 기반. ConfigMap에서 아래 환경변수를 설정:
- `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`: alloy 수집기 (`cmn-infra-observability` 네임스페이스)
- `JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS`: `-javaagent` + `-Dotel.experimental.config.file` 조합
- Prometheus 메트릭: 포트 8081 (`/actuator/prometheus`), 서비스 포트와 별도

## 새 서비스 추가 시

1. `search-api/`를 복사하여 시작 (가장 심플한 패턴)
2. `_helpers.tpl`의 모든 `search-api` → 새 서비스 이름으로 치환
3. 모든 `templates/*.yaml`의 `include` 호출도 동일하게 치환
4. `values.yaml`에 `ingress`, `autoscaling`, `config`, `replicaCount` 기본값 필수 (lint 통과 조건)
5. Kafka가 필요하면 `dynamic-indexer/templates/configmap.yaml` 참조
6. Multi-container가 필요하면 `search-admin/` 참조 (`containers[]` 배열 + 별도 deployment 템플릿)
